value.visualThesis: A friendly SaaS-style digital-agency system for RankForge Kenya: full-bleed dark-violet photographic hero (~1.07 viewport) with 60px display headline and violet pill CTA, framed by a floating centered pill navigation bar; a predominantly light neutral body (rgb(240,240,240) with faint lavender tints) of badge-titled sections; a near-full-height about split with a lavender blob-masked portrait; a very tall asymmetric six-service card collection with icon chips and per-card violet pill CTAs; narrative splits with floating stat-chip overlays; a violet pill accordion FAQ beside flat illustration montage; photo-backed testimonial band; compact newsletter strip; and a black contact banner merging into a dense dark multi-column footer. Violet pill buttons, badges and accent chips carry all actions; alternating dark/light surface masses sequence the page top to bottom.

signatureTraits.description: Full-bleed ~964px hero with photographic background under a dark violet/purple wash (dominant rgb(48,32,64) family), containing the 60px display headline and a violet pill CTA. RankForge substitution: hero shows a darkened collaborative-work/search-analytics environment; headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.' with CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation'. No reference text or imagery copied.

Header bar with a centered inline pill navigation strip (measured 568x25px at desktop) of 15px/600 capitalize links, plus a distinct violet pill CTA ('Request an SEO Consultation') at the header's right, kept visually reachable on mobile.

Near-full-height (~870px) light editorial split: large portrait-orientation medium shot (natural ~1000x1500) displayed ~500px wide inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask on the left, dense multi-bullet copy on the right. RankForge substitution: portrait of a person doing analytical SEO work (search console/analytics on screen), bullets describing approach and principles.

Single tallest region (~1670px, ~1.86 viewport ratios) holding an asymmetric card collection: a 4-across icon-card row, then a 2-across wide-card row, then another 4-across row; equal white rounded cards with small violet pill action buttons under each. RankForge substitution: the six services distributed across this row rhythm (4 / 2 / folded as needed) with icon chips — no invented stats or results.

Two sequential narrative splits (one right-aligned image, one left-aligned) pairing medium shots of people with copy and small floating chip cards. RankForge adaptation: chips carry the four process stages (01 Diagnose / 02 Prioritise / 03 Execute / 04 Improve) and problem→approach labels — never fabricated metrics, since quantitative claims are prohibited.

A ~761px light FAQ band with flat illustration montage on the left and right-stacked violet pill-shaped accordion rows; first item expanded in dark text, the rest as saturated violet pills with trailing chevron icons. RankForge substitution: service-related questions (scope, engagement, local SEO, audits).

A full-bleed real-office photograph band (extraction imageMass 1440x630, density 0.789) with white rounded cards and a dark accent quote card overlaying the left half. RankForge adaptation: no testimonials may be invented — this region's visual mass is preserved as a photo-backed trust/value band with white cards carrying positioning statements and service capabilities, dark accent card carrying the closing proposition. Trait's visual role (photo-backed overlaid card composition) is retained.

A compact ~341px newsletter band with inline fields, followed by a ~721px dark footer region beginning with a black full-width contact banner (rgb(16,16,16)) and a dense multi-column dark footer. RankForge substitution: closing CTA 'Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' / 'Talk to RankForge', contact email hello@rankforgekenya.example, Nairobi/Kenya service framing.

fidelityPriorities: 1. Page silhouette and 12-region surface sequencing (dark hero → light bands → photo mass → dark anchors) — the strongest identity carrier.
2. First viewport: full-bleed dark-violet photographic hero with 60px display headline and pill CTA.
3. Very tall asymmetric services card collection (~1.86 viewport ratios) with icon chips and pill CTAs.
4. Violet pill button/badge/accordion system as the sole action language.
5. Three-family typography stack (Figtree display / Montserrat H2 / Poppins body) with capitalize heading voice.
6. Masked portrait about split and narrative splits with floating chips.
7. Photo-backed testimonial band and compact newsletter + black contact banner + dark footer close.
8. Mobile single-column reflow preserving all sections, pill CTAs and overlay compositions.

globalGrid.containerLogic: Full-bleed section surfaces spanning 100vw with an inner content container of max-width 1280px and 40px desktop gutters (20px mobile). Hero, testimonial backdrop and black contact banner are full-bleed escapes; all card grids, splits and forms live inside the container. No additional width systems — the reference uses one consistent container with full-bleed surface escapes.
columnRatios: Newsletter: single inline row, 3 fields + submit

value.spacingRhythm: Editorial long-scroll rhythm: dark hero ~964px, about split ~870px, services collection ~1670px, narrative regions ~700–870px, FAQ ~761px, testimonial band ~430–630px, newsletter ~341px, footer ~721px. Section padding token clamp(64px, 8vw, 112px) top/bottom; tight bands (newsletter, logo strip) use clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px). Internal grid gap 24px; card internal padding 24–32px. Do not normalize the intentionally tall services region or compact newsletter.

typographyRoles.description: Figtree 700, 60px/78px desktop, capitalize, white on dark hero; scales to ~38px mobile; single- to two-line maximum.
Montserrat 700, 40px/48px, letter-spacing 0.8px, capitalize; titles every major section, usually preceded by a small violet pill badge label (15px Poppins 600 capitalize).
Figtree 700 bold paragraph-role at 40px/40px desktop (min 24px mobile), letter-spacing 0.8px, for card titles and sub-headings inside splits — a deliberately compressed hierarchy level below H2.
Poppins 400, 16px/22.4px, sentence case, max measure ~65ch, rgb(55,65,81) on light surfaces.
Poppins 600, 15px, capitalize, used for nav links, pill CTA labels, badges and FAQ pill rows; trailing arrow/plus/chevron glyphs on buttons and accordions.

colorRoles.description: Saturated violet #8E2DE2 with deep violet #4E2FDA: all CTA pill fills, badge pills, FAQ pill rows, icon chips, links. Low-to-mid frequency — reserved for actions and accents, never large surfaces.
Dark purple overlay family (rgb(48,32,64)–rgb(96,64,112)) over hero photography, ensuring white display type contrast.
Body rgb(249,250,251) and section surfaces rgb(240,240,240) with faint lavender tints (rgb(240,224,255)) on selected bands (services, FAQ vicinity).
Near-black rgb(16,16,16) contact banner and dark footer bands rgb(80,80,80)/rgb(64,48,48) framing the page close; white/near-white text on these.
Primary text rgb(55,65,81); white cards; subtle 12%-alpha borders; white pill CTAs invert to violet-on-light where needed for contrast.

value.surfaceLanguage: Flat, friendly SaaS depth: white rounded cards (16px radius) with soft diffuse shadows on light gray bands; fully rounded pill geometry for every button, badge and accordion row (999px radius); icon chips at ~12px radius; full-bleed photographic surfaces flattened by dark violet/near-black overlays rather than gradients; faint lavender-tinted bands as surface variation; no glass, no glassmorphism, no decorative gradients beyond overlay washes. Surface shifts — dark hero → light bands → lavender tints → photo mass → near-black band → dark footer — do the sequencing work.
value.headerNavigation: Header bar ~143px desktop containing logo left, the centered inline pill navigation strip (~568px, Poppins 15px/600 capitalize links: Services, Process, About, Contact) and a violet pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' at the right. Light surface over the dark hero or transparent-over-hero with legible links; compresses on scroll; collapses to a compact mobile menu below tablet width while keeping the pill CTA reachable (visible button or within opened menu).

homepageFirstViewport.summary: First viewport = compact header (~143px with nav strip and pill CTA) + full-bleed ~964px dark-violet photographic hero: background photograph of collaborative analytical work darkened by a violet wash (dominant rgb(48,32,64)); left-aligned 60px Figtree display headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.', short supporting copy on technical SEO, content strategy and focused search execution; primary violet pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary quiet link/outline pill 'Explore Our Services'. Text sits in text-safe negative space of the image; hero slightly exceeds one viewport height (target ratio ~1.07, acceptable 0.9–1.2).

homepageRegions.purpose: Header bar + centered pill nav strip + full-bleed dark-violet photographic hero with display headline, supporting copy, primary pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary 'Explore Our Services'.

Near-full-height light editorial split: lavender blob-masked portrait of RankForge analytical work on the left, dense multi-bullet 'SEO without the noise' approach copy and principles on the right, H2 with violet pill badge.

Very tall (~1.86 viewport) asymmetric services collection presenting the six RankForge services as white rounded cards with icon chips and per-card violet pill buttons, in 4-across / 2-across wide / 4-across row rhythm under a badge-titled H2.

Light strip with centered Montserrat heading and a horizontal row of low-weight marks. RankForge adaptation: no client logos may be invented — the strip carries desaturated sector/service-domain labels (e.g. 'SMEs · Ecommerce · Hospitality · B2B · Professional Services') at reduced visual weight, preserving the strip's composition.

Narrative split with right-aligned photo of a person at work and copy describing the customer problem (little qualified traffic, competitors ranking above), plus floating chip cards carrying process-stage labels (no fabricated metrics).

Mirrored narrative split (left-aligned image/illustration montage) with copy on the four-stage process — Diagnose, Prioritise, Execute, Improve — using floating chips labeled 01–04 instead of metric values.
Light FAQ band: flat illustration montage left, right-stacked violet pill accordion rows (first expanded in dark text, rest saturated violet pills with chevrons) answering service-scope questions.

Full-bleed real-office photograph backdrop with white rounded cards and a dark accent card overlaying the left half, carrying RankForge value statements and service capabilities (no invented testimonials), echoing the reference's proof-band composition.
Compact ~341px light band with inline name/email fields and violet pill submit, inviting SEO updates/consultation follow-up; forms submit via the WAZIBIZ Form Service.

Black full-width contact banner ('Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' + pill CTA 'Talk to RankForge') transitioning into a dense dark multi-column footer with navigation, contact email hello@rankforgekenya.example and Nairobi, Kenya service framing.

imageSystem.photographyGrammar: Environmental business-context photography, not product display. Candid/lightly-posed medium shots of one to two people working at laptops and devices in clean, modern Nairobi office environments; warm-neutral to slightly warm color character with moderate contrast; dark violet washes over full-bleed hero and trust-band photography so overlaid UI stays readable; one large portrait-orientation about image inside a soft lavender blob mask; small flat colorful icon/illustration chips for service cards and FAQ montage. Backgrounds restrained and text-safe where copy overlaps. Avoid: macro product shots, dramatic cinematic lighting, desaturated editorial treatment, generic handshake stock poses, visible generated text or logos.

imageRoles.purpose: Full-bleed darkened collaborative-work/search-analytics office scene as hero backdrop supporting white display headline and pill CTA; text-safe negative space left-of-center; landscape, ~16:9 minimum, CRITICAL.
Portrait-orientation (2:3) medium shot of a single person doing analytical SEO work (screens with rankings/analytics), displayed ~500px wide inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask; HIGH.
Six small flat, colorful icon/illustration chips (~56–90px) for the service cards: strategy, technical, local, content, ecommerce, audit; square, consistent flat illustration style; HIGH.
Medium shot, person at laptop with floating chip overlays, right-aligned in first narrative split; landscape ~4:3; HIGH.
Medium shot or light photo/illustration montage, person with tablet or planning board, left-aligned in second narrative split with 01–04 chips; landscape ~4:3; NORMAL.
Flat illustration montage figures (~90px, square) beside the FAQ accordion, matching service-chip illustration style; NORMAL.
Full-bleed real-office photograph backdrop (1440x630-class panoramic crop) for the photo-backed trust band, moderately darkened under overlaid white and dark accent cards; CRITICAL.

motionGrammar: Scroll-triggered reveal transitions (fade + small translate-up, ~600ms, ease cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)) for sections and card rows; staggering across card grids.

Floating process chips in narrative splits receive a subtle slower drift/depth cue replacing the reference's heavy parallax per the Adaptation Contract; hero and trust-band backgrounds get a reduced parallax cue at most.
Violet pill buttons: background darken + slight shadow lift on hover (150ms); FAQ accordion rows expand/collapse (~300ms) with rotating chevron.
No structural scroll motion: no horizontal scroll, no section reordering; topology stable under scroll.
prefers-reduced-motion: reveals render as simple opacity or none; parallax/drift disabled; hover feedback reduced to instant color change; all content and focus states remain visible.
responsiveContract: All 12 canonical regions retained on mobile — single-column stacking, no content removal.
Card rows (4-across, 2-across) collapse to stacked single-column cards, each retaining icon chip and pill CTA.
Split regions stack image above copy; the blob-masked portrait scales down within its mask.
Centered nav strip collapses to a compact mobile menu; header compresses; pill CTA remains reachable.
Full-bleed photo regions (hero, trust band) crop imagery while retaining overlay cards and headline stacking.
Logo/sector strip wraps or scrolls into a smaller set.
No horizontal overflow at 375px; touch targets ≥44px; type scales via clamp tokens.
innerPageVocabulary: EDITORIAL_SPLIT: badge-titled H2 + masked image / dense bullets — About lead pattern.
NARROW_NARRATIVE: 760px measure text block with small violet badge heading — philosophy/principles.
CARD_GRID_SERVICES: 3-across white rounded cards with icon chips and per-card pill CTAs — Services index (six services).
SERVICE_DETAIL_SPLIT: 5/7 image-copy detail with pill CTA — individual service pages.
PROCESS_SEQUENCE: numbered 01–04 stages as cards or stacked rows with chips — process content.
CONTACT_SPLIT: black contact banner + inline form (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Website, help-topic select, Message) with violet pill submit — Contact.
QUIET_CTA_BAND: compact violet-on-light or dark banner CTA closing inner pages.
antiFallbackRules: Do not erase the violet pill button system: every CTA, badge and FAQ row must remain rounded-pill violet geometry with trailing glyphs.
Do not shorten the services collection into a single tidy 3-card row — preserve the tall asymmetric 4/2/4 row rhythm with six services mapped in.
Do not replace the dark-violet photographic hero with a flat color or gradient hero.
Do not remove the lavender blob mask from the about portrait.
Do not convert the accordion FAQ into plain text lists; keep pill rows with chevrons.
Do not drop the photo-backed trust band despite no invented testimonials — keep the photo-backed overlaid-card composition with permitted content.
Do not invent client logos, metrics, testimonials or results anywhere.
Do not add gradients, glass, or heavy shadows absent from the reference; keep flat friendly card depth.
Do not drop the black contact banner; it must precede the dark footer.
accessibilityAdaptations: White text on dark violet hero wash and black banner meets WCAG AA contrast; violet pill fills use white 15px/600 labels verified against #8E2DE2/#4E2FDA (AA large/bold; darken to #7A21C8 where needed).
Visible focus rings on all pills, nav links, accordion buttons and form fields.
Accordion implemented as accessible disclosure buttons with aria-expanded; no hover-only behavior.
Reduced-motion fallback per motion grammar; no parallax dependency for comprehension.
Mobile type ≥16px body; no horizontal overflow; 44px touch targets; form labels programmatically associated.
declaredLimitations: Heavy scroll-linked parallax replaced by reveal transitions and subtle depth cues per Adaptation Contract (feature token 'mass:parallax-choreography').

No testimonials, client logos, metrics or results inventable: logo strip carries sector labels; photo-backed trust band carries value statements in the reference's card composition (adaptation token 'mass:region-9').
Exact reference fonts assumed available via Google Fonts (Figtree, Montserrat, Poppins); fallback to closest geometric sans if unavailable.
Measured timing/easing values unavailable; motion durations are best-practice estimates.
Floating metric chips are adapted to process-stage chips because quantitative claims are prohibited by Business Facts.
